resources.string: Read-only caller-visible evidence. No account changes or platform verdict. Nothing runs until you tap.

This contacts Google through its public API using your project number. Ordinary reports save token receipt metadata only. A separate prompt offers optional private token retention for export. Decoded verdicts require backend verification and remain NOT_RUN.
Choose a profile file and enter its Cyclone profile ID and measured artifact digest.
Select a profile JSON. No checks have run.
Selected profile hash: %1$s\nTap Collect to begin.
INVALID_BINDING: Select a valid profile JSON and binding.
INVALID_BINDING: Select a valid profile, IDs and SHA-256. Integrity also requires a valid project number.
Saved reports/%1$s.json\n%2$s\nLocal evidence only. Integrity verdict NOT_RUN.
Optional. Keeps one encrypted token privately. Export expires after 24 hours. New collection or successful export removes it. Never include it in diagnostics or public evidence.
This sensitive file is for your local backend only. It contains no decoded verdict. Do not publish or share it in diagnostics.
